title: Red-Teaming a Lightweight Agent Monitor: Can Prompt Crafting Bypass Classifier-Based Oversight?

original_idea.body:
# Red-Teaming a Lightweight Agent Monitor: Can Prompt Crafting Bypass Classifier-Based Oversight?

**Problem:** METR found bypass vectors in Anthropic's sophisticated monitoring infrastructure. It is unknown whether similar attacks work against simple, publicly available classifier-based monitors used by small teams.

**Direction:** Implement a simple classifier-based agent monitor using an open-source LLM (e.g., Llama-3-8B as a 'judge'). Then systematically attempt to bypass it using known prompt injection, rephrasing, and covert channel techniques. Document successful bypasses and measure attack success rates.

**Why it matters:** Most organizations cannot deploy Anthropic-grade monitoring. Understanding bypass rates for lightweight monitors informs what safety guarantees are realistic for resource-constrained deployments.

**Relevant context:** METR 2026 red-teaming findings; Anthropic Opus 4.6 Sabotage Risk Report.
